name: Escape Through Stealth
summary: In Darkshore, Volcor needs help escaping a furbolg den. Guide the trapped night elf scout past hostile beasts, then report to Terenthis in Auberdine.

sections.title: The Trapped Scout
sections.body: Volcor, a night elf scout sent to investigate Darkshore's mounting threats, is trapped inside a furbolg cave. Cut off from the main roads and outnumbered, he needs an ally to help him escape before the furbolgs discover him.

sections.title: A Careful Flight
sections.body: Volcor chooses a careful path through the cave instead of charging the corrupted denizens. Once outside, he runs ahead on foot and asks you to meet him in Auberdine, where he can travel faster alone.

sections.title: Reporting to Auberdine
sections.body: Back in Auberdine, you bring news of Volcor's rescue to Terenthis, a night elf leader working to protect the troubled coast. Volcor's safe return shows that discipline and teamwork can resist the darkness spreading through Darkshore and the wilderness beyond.

faq.answer: Volcor is a night elf scout sent into Darkshore's wilderness on a mission for his superiors. He became trapped in a furbolg cave until an Alliance adventurer rescued him.

faq.q: Why does Volcor run off alone once outside the cave?
faq.answer: Volcor says he can travel faster alone once clear of the cave's narrow passages. He asks you to meet him in Auberdine rather than travel together along the open roads.
Terenthis is a night elf leader stationed in Auberdine. He coordinates local scouting and organizes responses to the corruption and hostile denizens threatening Darkshore.

faq.q: Where does this rescue take place?
faq.answer: The rescue begins inside a furbolg cave in Darkshore's wild, contested forests, far from Auberdine.

faq.q: What happens after completing this quest?
aliases: what comes after escape through stealth
faq.answer: After Volcor is safely accounted for and Terenthis has heard your report, your journey continues south toward Ashenvale with Trek to Ashenvale.

faq.q: What is the alternative to stealth in this rescue?
faq.answer: Volcor offers another approach: instead of slipping out quietly, adventurers can fight their way through in a separate escort option.

angles.text: As a night elf, helping Volcor supports the network of scouts watching Kalimdor's troubled forests as corruption spreads from barrows and dens.
As a rogue, you can appreciate Volcor's choice to bypass an entrenched enemy rather than risk a reckless frontal fight.
As an Alliance ally, helping Volcor escape shows the night elf leadership in Auberdine that non-kaldorei allies can be trusted with delicate work in the wilderness.
